content:
-STOCK PHOTO

Every September, one day of the month hits a little differently. On the True Tours Haunted History Tour, that means the ghosts come forward a little quicker and show themselves a bit more.

Oct. 26 is National Ghost Hunting Day, and True Tours is doing what they do every Saturday, but with a little twist. Guests are encouraged to bring their own paranormal equipment, and they’ll stay a bit longer at those historic buildings that have been active in the last year.

“On the tour we really lean into the history of these places,” said paranormal author and True Tours guide Christopher Balzano. “One day of the year we strongly encourage the evidence part of things, and those locations seem to know we’re looking.”

“Just about every tour, someone gets a picture we can’t explain or something happens,” said Balzano, who has been investigating the paranormal and looking into haunted folklore for thirty years. “On National Ghost Hunting Day, we linger, and I show guests how to use equipment. The last two years have been active on National Ghost Hunting Day, so we’re hoping that continues. Much of it has to do with the energy of the crowd we bring out and our local connection to these locations.” According to Balzano, the tour introduces many guests to old and new ways to look for ghosts.

This year, some of the newer stories will be focused on. Guests may help True Tours answer who the new woman is walking through The Courthouse or if the recent renovations at the old Hotel Greystone are impacting the ghosts in the Patio de Leon and Bootlegger’s Alley.

Balzano will still be sharing the spooky, including some new tales from the Arcade and Arts for Act, but the focus will be the evidence…and the experiences.

And all guests have a chance to win a free ticket to our upcoming Burroughs Home Investigation Event in October.

It’s Fort Myers’ stories…True Tours just has the honor of telling them to you.

Call 239-945-0405 to book for the night or visit www.truetours.net to see all of their upcoming special events.
